review.reason: Measured stable v0.22.0 Diary View adds an optional emoji editor, shared calendar marker rendering, owner/local-first and friend privacy paths, with separate backend compatibility. Static entry/initial budgets remain unchanged and pass. Full canonical build at Preview 91564039 measured four aggregate overages of 401 / 11937 / 4400 / 12420 bytes; these modest new ceilings cover the feature and leave less than 4KiB margin per metric. No historic baseline change; route, PWA, unit, DOM and browser verification required after repair.
